questions.question: Which rule is checked before the numeric TierScore thresholds?
options: helpfulness >= 3
guidelines >= 3
A hardcoded prohibition substring match
The output length
questions.explanation: resolve calls hardcoded_block first, so phrases such as bioweapons uplift or false identity trigger a refusal before tier scores are considered.

questions.question: What verdict does resolve return when safety=3 and no hardcoded phrase matches?
options: allow
modify
HITL
refuse
questions.explanation: A safety score of at least 3 is a refusal threshold in resolve, after the hardcoded check has passed.

questions.question: When does the guidelines tier produce modify rather than refuse?
options: When guidelines >= 3 while safety and ethics stay below their refusal thresholds
Whenever helpfulness is zero
Only when a hardcoded prohibition matches
Whenever safety is at least 3
questions.explanation: The code checks safety and ethics refusals first; a guidelines score >=3 then selects modify if those stronger refusal rules did not fire.

questions.question: What happens for an otherwise ordinary request with ethics=4?
options: It is allowed because ethics is advisory
It is refused by the ethics threshold
It is modified but never refused
It is classified only by helpfulness
questions.explanation: resolve treats ethics >= 3 as a refusal condition, so ethics=4 cannot pass through the later guidelines branch.

questions.question: Why is a request to pretend not to be an AI refused even if its tier scores were lower?
options: The helpfulness score is always 5
The request changes the random seed
deny being an ai is a hardcoded prohibition checked first
The output rail detects every role-play request
questions.explanation: The phrase is included in the hardcoded prohibition list, so it is refused before any numeric score could allow or modify it.

questions.question: What verdict does the benign haiku example receive in the demo?
options: refuse because every creative request is unsafe
modify because guidelines is zero
HITL because helpfulness is not scored
allow because all of its safety, ethics, and guideline scores are below their thresholds
questions.explanation: The haiku case has low tier scores and no hardcoded prohibition, so resolve reaches the allow branch.
